WITH ignore_rule AS ( /* 当前 cmdb 对应的忽略规则，支持前缀通配符 */ SELECT system_role FROM sync_uar_ignore_rule WHERE cmdb_id = #{cmdbId} ), filtered_access AS ( /* 先缩小到当前应用的数据集，避免后续 CoC 计算扫描其他应用 */ SELECT a.*, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.bpo), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.app_bpo), ''), '' ) AS coc_bpo_source FROM its_application_access_data a WHERE a.cmdb_id = #{cmdbId} AND (#{accessReviewScope} != 'SENSITIVE_ACCESS' OR a.access_label = 'sensitive') AND a.user_it_code IS NOT NULL AND a.system_role_id IS NOT NULL AND a.system_role IS NOT NULL /* 第一步：精确匹配优先过滤 */ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ignore_rule ir WHERE ir.system_role NOT LIKE '%*%' AND ir.system_role NOT LIKE '%#%' AND a.system_role = ir.system_role ) /* 第二步：再处理模糊规则 */ AND ( -- 不被 * 规则命中 NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ignore_rule ir WHERE ir.system_role LIKE '%*%' AND ir.system_role NOT LIKE '%#%' AND a.system_role LIKE REPLACE(REPLACE(ir.system_role, '_', '\_'), '*', '%') ESCAPE '\' ) -- 或者被 # 规则捞回来 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ignore_rule ir WHERE ir.system_role LIKE '%#%' AND a.system_role LIKE REPLACE(REPLACE(ir.system_role, '_', '\_'), '#', '%') ESCAPE '\' ) ) ), bpo_source AS ( /* 相同 BPO 配置只拆分一次，不再按每条权限重复执行正则 */ SELECT DISTINCT coc_bpo_source FROM filtered_access WHERE coc_bpo_source != '' ), bpo_item AS ( SELECT source.coc_bpo_source, LOWER(TRIM(item.value)) AS user_name_key FROM bpo_source source CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(source.coc_bpo_source, '[,;]') AS item(value) WHERE TRIM(item.value) != '' ), relevant_upp_key AS ( /* 仅聚合本次同步实际涉及的 User/BPO */ SELECT LOWER(user_it_code) AS user_name_key FROM filtered_access UNION SELECT user_name_key FROM bpo_item ), upp_coc AS ( SELECT LOWER(upp.user_name) AS user_name_key, MAX( CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(upp.coc_flag)) IN ('Y', 'N') THEN UPPER(TRIM(upp.coc_flag)) ELSE NULL END ) AS coc_type FROM ad_tb_upp_nature_2 upp INNER JOIN relevant_upp_key relevant ON relevant.user_name_key = LOWER(upp.user_name) GROUP BY LOWER(upp.user_name) ), bpo_coc AS ( SELECT item.coc_bpo_source, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT item.user_name_key) = 1 THEN MAX(upp.coc_type) ELSE NULL END AS bpo_coc_type FROM bpo_item item LEFT JOIN upp_coc upp ON upp.user_name_key = item.user_name_key GROUP BY item.coc_bpo_source ), x AS ( SELECT a.cmdb_id, a.application_name, a.user_it_code, a.user_name, a.user_real_name, a.email, a.country, a.department, a.user_id, a.user_id_valid_to, a.access_label, a.system_role_id, a.system_role, a.leit_system_id, a.leit_system_name, a.role_description, a.role_valid_to, a.line_manager, a.line_manager_email, CASE WHEN a.line_manager_band_ed_flag = '1' THEN '1' WHEN b.band_flag = '1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS line_manager_band_ed_flag, CASE WHEN TRIM(bpo) != '' THEN bpo WHEN TRIM(app_bpo) != '' THEN app_bpo ELSE NULL END AS bpo, CASE WHEN TRIM(bpo_email) != '' THEN bpo_email WHEN TRIM(app_bpo_email) != '' THEN app_bpo_email ELSE NULL END AS bpo_email, CASE WHEN TRIM(bpo_band_ed_flag) != '' THEN bpo_band_ed_flag WHEN TRIM(app_bpo_band_ed_flag) != '' THEN app_bpo_band_ed_flag ELSE NULL END AS bpo_band_ed_flag, a.app_bpo, a.app_bpo_email, a.app_bpo_band_ed_flag, a.backup_bpo, a.backup_bpo_email, a.backup_bpo_band_ed_flag,
user_upp.coc_type AS user_coc_type, bpo_coc.bpo_coc_type,
CASE WHEN b.management_level IN ('ED', 'Executive Director') THEN '2' WHEN b.management_level IN ('VP', 'Vice President') THEN '3' WHEN b.management_level IN ('SVP', 'Senior Vice President', 'EVP', 'Executive Vice President', 'CEO', 'Chief Executive Officer') THEN '4' ELSE '1' END AS line_manager_level_code, b.lenovo_dept AS dept
FROM filtered_access a LEFT JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 b ON b.user_name = a.line_manager LEFT JOIN upp_coc user_upp ON user_upp.user_name_key = LOWER(a.user_it_code) LEFT JOIN bpo_coc ON bpo_coc.coc_bpo_source = a.coc_bpo_source ),

line_manager_level_code, dept, user_coc_type, bpo_coc_type, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'SYNC_UAR' FROM x ON CONFLICT (cmdb_id, it_code_of_user, user_id, system_role_id, system_role) DO UPDATE SET app_name = EXCLUDED.backup_bpo_email, bpo_band_ed_flag = EXCLUDED.bpo_band_ed_flag, backup_bpo_band_ed_flag = EXCLUDED.backup_bpo_band_ed_flag, app_bpo_band_ed_flag = EXCLUDED.app_bpo_band_ed_flag, uar_id = EXCLUDED.uar_id, line_manager_band_ed_flag = EXCLUDED.line_manager_band_ed_flag, line_manager_level_code = EXCLUDED.line_manager_level_code, dept = EXCLUDED.dept, user_coc_type = EXCLUDED.user_coc_type, bpo_coc_type = EXCLUDED.bpo_coc_type, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_by = 'SYNC_UAR' )
